_about: The career framework every company follows. Source: the Career Progression guidelines (IC1 to IC6). Level N of a ladder here is ICN on an individual-contributor ladder; management and executive ladders use the same numbering and show it as LN. Each rung in content/careers/roles/*.json describes its level in the three measures below. Copy content/careers/_template.json to add a role.

measures.name: Knowledge
measures.means: Breadth and depth of knowledge; how their area(s) of expertise develop over time.

measures.name: Delivery
measures.means: What they are expected to deliver and how they go about doing that.

measures.name: Communication & leadership
measures.means: How they communicate and lead people and/or projects across the business.

levels.theme: A supporting-level player who is honing their craft and working to understand organizational context.
An established performer with strong communication skills who proactively builds relationships.
A high-level performer with strong relationships and the ability to lead projects.
A leading performer who prefers to manage projects over managing people.
A recognised expert whose judgement the whole company relies on.

sublevels.name: Established
sublevels.means: Strong experience at that level. Standing to take on half the competencies in the level above.

sublevels.name: Pushing for the next level
sublevels.means: Nailing their level. Comfortable with most of the competencies in the level above.

sublevelRule: Computed, never stored: of the next level's passable steps, fewer than half met = .0, half or more = .1, three quarters or more = .2.
